# control zone (CTR)

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:overlayTypeControlZone`](gmeow-overlayTypeControlZone.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/overlayTypeControlZone>
- **Category:** individual
